Dear [Mr Craik](/person/379)
Many thanks for [the payment](/topic/160) which comes pleasantly early this year.

My [Spaniards and Moors](/book/126) are progressing, but I suppose I had better finish all before I send them, as if abridgement is needful it is better done on a whole than on a part.

Yours truly

C M Yonge


[^1]: Black-edged paper.
